text: Lift Athena's per-agent spending and time caps for now (owner's direction, 4 Nov: 'lift budgets for now if they're causing so many issues'). In athena.toml change only these values: [budget] reader_usd 0.50 -> 2.00, producer_usd 3.00 -> 10.00, verifier_usd 2.00 -> 5.00, job_usd 12.00 -> 40.00, producer_timeout_s 3000 -> 5400, verifier_timeout_s 2400 -> 3600; [job_plan] planner_usd 0.75 -> 3.00, critic_usd 0.75 -> 3.00, max_rounds 3 -> 5. No new keys. Since 2 Nov these caps ended at least 6 jobs early: two planners out of budget, two plans out of rounds, a writer out of time, and two verifier timeouts. Acceptance: athena.toml holds exactly these values; the installed build and check-config read it without error; the existing config tests pass.
